summary: New provisional entry ḥwtk: surface mḥawtək- supports a tentative Q classification, not a secure inherited triliteral I. Only Imperativ and Infectum are directly attested; the Infectum base is inferred from 2sg mḥawtəkatlan and no Preterit is reconstructed.

The Turoyo itself contrasts hearing the visitors with expelling them and denies the right to expel them; the later command targets aṣ ṣəroye. Turkish quoted speech supplies a contact context, not an etymology or a substitute for Turoyo semantic evidence.
